newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rican arrested for Clinton bomb hoax.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rican arrested for Clinton bomb hoax.

text.p: Costa Rican police last week briefly arrested a youth for making prank bomb threats during the visit of U.S. President Bill Clinton, officials said on Monday.
"They were jokes of bad taste," a high-ranking police official who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.

An official with Costa Rica's Supreme Court said the youth was arrested as Clinton arrived last Wednesday for a summit with the Central American leaders and was released two days later when Clinton departed. He gave no further details on the youth's identity.
The police official said the hotel where Clinton stayed received at least 10 bomb threats before the U.S. leader arrived.

Judicial officials, backed by members of Clinton's security detail, tracked down and arrested the youth -- though it was not clear if he was the responsible for all the calls, the police official said.
